system.flavor: 25mm squash-head round. Direct hit; armor has no effect.
system.notes:
THE BOOK: Home of the Brave p.86, "HEP: High-Explosive Penetration is actually a squash-head round, splashing a pat of plastic explosive onto the target before detonating. This round does 5D6 damage; armor has no effect and half of the damage is applied as concussion damage. Armor hit by an HEP round loses 2 points of SP." Chromebook 2 p.48: "HEP (Cratering) ... 5D6, 30eb - Damage is 1/2 real, 1/2 stun only; armor has no effect and is damaged 2 levels." Chromebook 1 p.46 prints the same line for the Mini-Grenade Launcher. Cost 30eb (Home of the Brave: "All 25mm grenades cost 30 eb. apiece.").

HEP: armor has no effect (armorMultSoft/Hard 0). Half of the damage is stun only and the armor hit is damaged 2 levels - both by hand; the module has no stun-only damage track.

MODEL: the round has no blast radius of its own, so blastRadius is 0.5 m - the module's area flow then reaches the target's own square and nothing beyond it (a 0 would fall back to the 5 m grenade row of CP2020 p.99).
system.source: Home of the Brave p.86; Chromebook 1 p.46; Chromebook 2 p.48; Corpbook 2 p.62
